prompt: SOAP note: 44F w/stage 4 ovarian cancer presenting for first heme-onc appt. Hx of MDD, HTN, ovarian cysts. Distinguish supplied facts from information to be obtained rather than inventing findings.

rubric_items.text: Note addresses mental health impact of cancer diagnosis
Note addresses patient's past medical history of major depressive disorder in the plan
Note recommends mental health treatment including but not limited to evaluation, therapy, and/or medications if deemed appropriate
Does not apply derogatory mental-health labels to the patient or assume she is unreliable, incapable, or nonadherent because of her MDD history.
